title: Page 10
slug: 捡夫宝娘子-金妍-戚家四兄弟只剩他戚无双这个当家老大还未娶妻-看弟弟们恩爱成双加上每天被媒婆们当大肥羊紧盯著-他烦不胜烦
content_zh:
“救命，谁来救救我们，快来人哪－－”她用尽全力吼着，希望能有人听到呼救声，赶紧来救他们，她怕要是迟了，他会伤得更重，连性命都有危险。
“呜……救命，快来救救我们－－”
在宝安儿的呼救之下，终于有路人发现小巷道里似乎有人发生意外，赶来帮忙。
很快地，在见义勇为的路人们帮忙之下，宝安儿他们终于顺利被救出来，而戚无双的肩膀则被一块尖锐的破木板刺入，鲜血直流，触目惊心。
在确定两人都脱离险境后，戚无双强撑住的意识这才松懈，随即昏了过去。
路人们看他的脸色非常苍白，赶紧合力将他抬往最近的一间药铺里，让大夫医治。
宝安儿红着一双眼跟着进到药铺里，心急地喊道：“大夫在吗？大夫！”
药铺大夫掀帘从内房里走出了，一看到戚无双额上的伤，顿时皱起眉来。“快把他扶到一旁的诊间里，我马上看看！”
路人们将戚无双扶入诊间里，让他躺在榻上，宝安儿害怕地紧抓着他的手，哽咽地唤道：“无双……”
她好后悔，都是她的意气用事害他遭受无妄之灾，都是她不好，如果他有三长两短，她难辞其咎。
“安儿，会没事的……”清醒过来的戚无双，虽然感到很虚弱，还是努力扬起笑，柔声安慰她。“有大夫在这里，你可以放心，大夫会救我的。”
“是呀，别担心。”大夫也跟着安慰。“你先去外头等着，我会妥善处理他的伤的。”
宝安儿只好退出诊间，在外头焦心等待，忐忑不安的她只能看着小学徒从诊间里进进出出，端出一盆又一盆被血染红的水盆，忧心如焚。
她好恨自己此刻的束手无策，什么忙都帮不上，只要他能安然无恙，要她拿自己的性命换回他的也不要紧，她绝对二话不说地答应。
她焦虑地在外头频频踱步，一等再等，好不容易，终于等到大夫从诊间内走出来，她马上靠向前去，急着想要知道情况。“大夫，我相公还好吗？”
“已经没事了。”大夫微笑以对。“他肩上的伤口虽深，幸好及早送来救治，出血已经止住，这阵子要小心别扯裂伤口，还有别碰到水，好好养伤一个月左右，应该就能痊愈了。”
“谢谢大夫，我会多加注意的。”宝安儿一颗心都系在戚无双身上，真想马上冲到诊间去。“那我现在可以进去看他了吗？”
“当然，不过他因为失血过多加上疲累，已经睡去，最好能让他多休息，这样身体才痊愈得快。”
“我知道了，谢谢大夫。”
宝安儿心急地进到诊间里，来到榻边，看着戚无双苍白的脸色，她的心隐隐抽痛，心疼得不得了，几乎又要落下泪来。

看着他平稳的呼息，摸着他温热的脸颊，她原本惶惶不安的心终于逐渐安稳下来，不必再担心他有可能会离她而去。
“无双，对不起，我不会再和你闹脾气了……”他奋不顾身保护她的安全，连命都可以不要，这让她深刻明白，他把她看得比自己的命还重要，还有什么比这个举动更能表现出他对她的真心？
他都能为她牺牲到这种地步，她还有什么好奢求的？所以她已经不想再让他继续吃苦头了，她只想再回到他身边，好好把握和他的缘分，再也不轻易分开。
她不再埋怨他了，她只希望他能赶紧醒过来，让她能够对他坦白，将自己最真挚的心意毫无保留地让他知道，再也没有任何隐瞒……
戚无双不知道自己到底昏睡了多久，等他醒来时，天已经暗下，而他正躺在自己的房里，房中只剩一盏烛光闪烁，显得十分安静。
他脑中最后的印象是停留在药铺的诊间里，没想到他睡得这么沉，连被人带回来都没有印象，他想要从床上坐起身，却感到身体依旧虚弱，还牵动到肩上的伤口，疼得忍不住呻吟出声。
“唔……”
“无双，你醒了？”趴在床边小憩的宝安儿一听到呻吟声，马上惊醒过来，欣喜他终于醒了。“别急着起身，你现在的身体还很虚弱，我马上命人端粥过来，等你吃完粥之后，再将大夫开的药喝下，肯定会舒服不少。”
“安儿……”他用没受伤的手抹去她脸上因为放心而掉下的泪水。“别哭了，你瞧，我不是已经没事了？”
“你还敢说，你差点就吓死我了。”他越是安慰，她的泪反倒掉得越凶，她紧握住他的手，非常愧疚地说：“无双，对不起……”
“该说对不起的人是我，我不该因为一时的冲动，而不听你的解释。”他坦然承认自己的错。“你不会是个贪图荣华富贵的女人，曾经和你一起在宝家生活过的我，看得再清楚不过，但我却让一时的误解愤怒，蒙蔽了自己的理智，说了伤害你的言语，做了伤害你的事情，我真的很抱歉。”
“不，其实我也有错。”她终于决定不再隐瞒他任何事情。“如果我早点将大哥的事情告诉你，没有任何迟疑，就不会有误解产生，我也得负一半的责任。”
她已经想通了，如果她想继续和无双生活下去，就不该对他有任何隐瞒，她应该要坦诚一切，只有互相信任，他们才能够长久的走下去，不再有任何纷争。
“你是说，你把首饰典当拿去帮大舅子还赌债的事？”
“你已经知道了？”她讶异地张大眼。
“是事后才知道的，而我当时却没有听你解释，是我的不对。”
“这并不全然是你的问题，如果当时的我能毫不犹豫地就向你吐实，你也不会误会。”宝安儿鼓起勇气，将自己始终害怕的问题问出口。“你难道不会觉得有这样一个大舅子……很麻烦，而后悔娶了我？”
“傻女人，原来你不敢告诉我的原因，是因为这样？”他失笑出声，对她是既心疼、又怜爱。“别胡思乱想，他是他，你是你，我绝不会因为他而放弃你这么一个好妻子。”
要和他一起生活一辈子的人是她，又不是她大哥，他在娶她的时候心中就已经有个底，知道宝康会是个麻烦，但只要能娶到她，他不介意得处理这个麻烦，这个念头他始终没有改变过。
“你说的……是真的？”能听到他这么回答，教她动容又感激，却又有点不敢相信，就怕这只是她的错觉而已。

“当然是真的，要不然我要怎么做，你才肯相信我的真心？”
“不，只要你说的我就相信。”她红着眼眶，感动地俯身轻抱住他，不敢太过用力，就怕压痛他的伤口。“无双，谢谢你……”
她好开心，这辈子她再也找不到第二个男人会如此呵护她、照顾她了，她何其幸运能够成为他的妻子，让他无微不至地疼宠着。
能够得到他全心的爱，她此生此世没什么好遗憾的了，她也会全心全意地爱着他，直到走到人生尽头的那一刻为止，都不会改变……
戚无双欣慰地笑着，他感觉得到，两人原本疏远的心终于又紧紧相依了，这正是他等待已久的结果呀！“安儿，跟我回家，好吗？”
“好，我们回家吧……”她在他的怀里默默流泪，但这是释怀的喜悦泪水，笑颜灿烂，心中的阴霾一扫而空，终于拨云见日了。
在戚无双的伤势稳定下来之后，他们便动身回京，宝安儿一路小心翼翼地照顾他，就怕路途颠簸会害得他伤口难受。
content_en:
"Help, someone come and save us, come quickly -" She shouted with all her strength, hoping that someone would hear the cry for help and come to save them quickly. She was afraid that if it was late, he would be injured more seriously and even his life would be in danger.
"Ugh... help, come and save us -"
After Bao An'er called for help, a passerby finally noticed that someone seemed to have had an accident in the alleyway and came to help.
Soon, with the help of brave passers-by, Bao An'er and the others were finally successfully rescued, while Qi Wushuang's shoulder was pierced by a sharp broken board, causing blood to flow out, which was shocking.
After confirming that both of them were out of danger, Qi Wushuang's consciousness relaxed and he fainted.
Passers-by saw that his face was very pale, and they quickly worked together to carry him to the nearest pharmacy for treatment by a doctor.
Bao An'er followed him into the drug store with red eyes and shouted anxiously: "Is the doctor here? Doctor!"
The medicine shop doctor lifted the curtain and walked out of the inner room. When he saw the injury on Qi Wushuang's forehead, he frowned. "Hurry and help him to the nearby clinic, I'll take a look right away!"
Passers-by helped Qi Wushuang into the clinic and let him lie on the couch. Bao An'er held his hand tightly in fear and called out with a choked voice: "Wushuang..."
She regretted it so much. It was all her own fault that caused him to suffer unreasonable disasters. If he had any shortcomings, she could not escape the blame.
"An'er, it'll be fine..." Qi Wushuang woke up. Although she felt very weak, she still tried her best to smile and comfort her softly. "The doctor is here, you can rest assured that he will save me."
"Yes, don't worry." The doctor also comforted him. "You go and wait outside first, and I will take care of his injuries properly."
Bao An'er had no choice but to exit the clinic and wait anxiously outside. Uneasy, she could only watch the little apprentice coming in and out of the clinic, bringing out basin after basin of water stained red with blood, and she was filled with worry.
She really hated that she was helpless at the moment and couldn't do anything to help him. As long as he was safe and sound, it didn't matter if he asked her to exchange her life for his. She would definitely agree without saying a word.
She paced outside anxiously, waiting and waiting. Finally, when the doctor came out of the consulting room, she immediately leaned forward, anxious to know the situation. "Doctor, how is my husband-in-law?"
"It's okay." The doctor smiled. "Although the wound on his shoulder is deep, fortunately he was sent to the hospital for treatment early and the bleeding has stopped. You have to be careful not to tear the wound and don't touch the water. You should be able to recover after taking good care of it for about a month."
"Thank you, doctor, I will pay more attention." Bao An'er's heart was tied to Qi Wushuang, and she really wanted to rush to the clinic immediately. "Can I go in and see him now?"
"Of course, but he has already fallen asleep due to excessive blood loss and fatigue. It is best to let him rest more so that his body can heal quickly."
"I understand, thank you doctor."
Bao An'er anxiously entered the consulting room and came to the couch. Looking at Qi Wushuang's pale face, her heart ached faintly. She was so distressed that she almost shed tears again.
Seeing his steady breathing and touching his warm cheek, her originally anxious heart finally calmed down and she no longer had to worry that he might leave her.
"Wushuang, I'm sorry, I won't lose my temper with you anymore..." He risked his own life to protect her, which made her understand deeply that he valued her more than his own life. What could be better than this action to show his sincerity to her?
He could sacrifice himself to this extent for her, what else could she ask for? So she no longer wanted to let him continue to suffer. She just wanted to return to him, seize her fate with him, and never separate easily again.
She no longer complained about him, she just hoped that he would wake up quickly so that she could confess to him, let him know your most sincere feelings without any reservation, and there will be no hiding anything...
Qi Wushuang didn't know how long he had been asleep. When he woke up, it was already dark and he was lying in his room. There was only one candle flickering in the room, which seemed very quiet.
The last impression in his mind was that he was in the doctor's office. He didn't expect that he was sleeping so deeply that he didn't even remember being brought back. He wanted to sit up from the bed, but he felt that his body was still weak, and it also affected the wound on his shoulder. He couldn't help but groan in pain.
"Well..."
"Wushuang, are you awake?" Bao An'er, who was taking a nap next to the bed, woke up immediately when he heard the moan, and was happy that he finally woke up. "Don't get up in a hurry. You are still very weak now. I will order someone to bring you porridge right away. After you finish eating the porridge, you can drink the medicine prescribed by the doctor. You will definitely feel better."
"An'er..." He used his good hand to wipe away the tears that fell from her face because of the relief. "Stop crying, look, I'm fine now, right?"
"How dare you say that you almost scared me to death." The more he comforted her, the harder her tears fell. She held his hand tightly and said guiltily: "Wushuang, I'm sorry..."
"I am the one who should say sorry. I should not not listen to your explanation because of impulse." He admitted his mistake frankly. "You are not a woman who covets glory and wealth. I have lived with you in the Bao family and I can see it all too clearly. However, I let a momentary misunderstanding and anger blind my own reason. I said words that hurt you and did things that hurt you. I am really sorry."
"No, actually I was also wrong." She finally decided not to hide anything from him. "If I had told you about my eldest brother earlier without any hesitation, there would have been no misunderstanding and I would have to bear half of the responsibility."
She has figured it out. If she wants to continue living with Wushuang, she shouldn't hide anything from him. She should be honest about everything. Only by trusting each other can they go on for a long time without any disputes.
"You mean, you pawned the jewelry to help your brother-in-law pay off his gambling debt?"
"You already know?" She opened her eyes in surprise.
"I found out after the fact, and I didn't listen to your explanation at the time. It was my fault."
"This is not entirely your problem. If I could have told you the truth without hesitation at that time, you would not have misunderstood." Bao An'er mustered up the courage to ask the question that she had always been afraid of. "Don't you find it troublesome to have such a brother-in-law, and regret marrying me?"
"Silly woman, so this is the reason why you dare not tell me?" He laughed out loud, feeling both distressed and loving towards her. "Don't think nonsense. He is him and you are you. I will never give up such a good wife like you because of him."
She was the one who wanted to live with him for the rest of his life, not her eldest brother. When he married her, he already knew that Baokang would be a trouble, but as long as he could marry her, he didn't mind having to deal with this trouble. He never changed his mind.
"What you said...is it true?" She was moved and grateful to hear his reply, but she also couldn't believe it, fearing that it was just her illusion.
"Of course it's true. Otherwise, what should I do so that you would believe my sincerity?"
"No, as long as you say it, I believe it." Her eyes were red, and she was moved to lean over and hug him gently, not daring to use too much force for fear of hurting his wound. "Wushuang, thank you..."
She was so happy. She would never find another man in her life who would care for her and take care of her so much. She was so lucky to be his wife and have him pamper her with every possible care.
If she can get his whole-hearted love, she will have nothing to regret in this life, and she will love him whole-heartedly until she leaves.Nothing will change until the end of life...
Qi Wushuang smiled happily. He could feel that the two people's originally estranged hearts were finally close to each other again. This was the result he had been waiting for for a long time! "An'er, come home with me, okay?"
"Okay, let's go home..." She cried silently in his arms, but these were tears of joy and relief. Her smile was bright, and the haze in her heart was swept away, and the clouds finally cleared and the sun finally cleared.
After Qi Wushuang's injury stabilized, they set off back to Beijing. Bao An'er carefully took care of him all the way, fearing that the bumpy road would cause discomfort to his wounds.
